pass_bar: holdout CLV > 0 (R3: ROI > 0) with one-sided p < 0.05/3

R1_spread_tue_unit_index.rule: bet the side favoured by the equal-weight unit-strength index (pass EPA, explosive-play, pressure, rush success: offense vs opposing defense, additive) when |index| >= 2.5; best allowed-book price (highest EV vs the snapshot's sharp fair line); one bet per game

R2_total_close_low_penalty_crew_under.snapshot: closing line (nflverse total_line, actual closing juice); referee known
R2_total_close_low_penalty_crew_under.rule: bet UNDER when the referee's shrunk penalties-per-game rating (z, 2013-19 scale) <= -1.0
R2_total_close_low_penalty_crew_under.metric: O/U ROI at actual closing juice vs break-even (one-sided t on per-bet profit)
R2_total_close_low_penalty_crew_under.secondary: same games at the Friday 21:40 snapshot (non-Thursday games): price-based CLV, informational

R3_total_close_sack_interaction_under.snapshot: closing line (nflverse total_line, actual closing juice)
R3_total_close_sack_interaction_under.rule: bet UNDER at the close when t_sack_int (sum over both offense-vs-defense pairings of z(off sack-avoidance) x z(def sack-allowance)) z-score >= 1.0 (2013-19 scale)
R3_total_close_sack_interaction_under.metric: O/U ROI at actual closing juice vs break-even (one-sided t on per-bet profit)
